a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly leaves us both with 0 when a storm hits. I intend to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random. Afterwards I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4 if the episode continues.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round, and I'm sorry this breaks our deal. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. I won't take anything more.
